text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I fear that something bizarre is
happening
to me.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Worry not—it has nothing to do with my
physical
condition. I simply... feel
absolutely buoyant with
joy.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Pitting myself against such powerful
rivals has me
feeling as though I am
walking on air...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Try as I might, I cannot control these
emotions...
What should I do?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Just take the moment to bask in your happiness.

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But my parents are always level-headed
and
never get worked up over
anything...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: You make a valid point...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
You're right. I am inclined to let this
unnamed
sensation wash over me right
now...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And I do not believe there is anything
inherently
wrong with that.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho is next. I cannot
wait to see
what my competition will be
like.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: What are you laughing about?
text_block_list.name: Манхэттен Кафе

text_block_list.text:
Oh? You saw that? I'm just happy to see
our
juniors having fun.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Back in the new year, you declared
you'd become
an obstacle to them.
text_block_list.name: Манхэттен Кафе

text_block_list.text: Why'd you say so?
text_block_list.name: Манхэттен Кафе

text_block_list.text:
Well, obstacles are meant to be
overcome, right?
Significant growth can't
happen without
conquering significant
hurdles.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: And if they don't improve enough, then we'll be the ones in trouble.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
You get it too, don't you? If not with
your head,
then with your heart.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
If I were to describe what it's like... Oh,
yes. It's
like parental love for one's
children.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Oh? There she goes. I must say, though...
Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Racing sure is fun.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
